idea.title: Ketkout — A Grand Entrance
idea.logline: A dramatic entrance, tiny determined footsteps, one irresistible jar and a tart-shaped idea.
idea.synopsis: Ketkout bursts into his own tiny kitchen. A side-on tracking shot follows his feet toward the table. From below the tabletop, his crown passes the Comfyture jar before he doubles back and grabs it. Holding the jar, he has an idea: the camera rises to a thought cloud containing a jam tart.

blocks.summary: A dramatic entrance introduces Ketkout and his tiny house.

blocks.action: The door bursts inward as if kicked; daylight reveals Ketkout, who settles at the threshold.
blocks.frame: Closed arched oak door. Camera inside the kitchen behind its swing. Warm window light.
blocks.sound: Wooden thump, air whoosh, short hinge rattle; no speech or music.
blocks.title: A grand entrance
blocks.endPrompt: Ketkout backlit in the open doorway, wing on the door, both feet planted.
blocks.videoPrompt: A single punchy four-second shot inside the miniature cottage kitchen. The camera begins on the fully closed arched wooden door. After a split-second of stillness, a sudden kick-like impact from outside sends the door flying inward to the left on its existing left-hand hinges, opening explosively in one fast swing. A sharp wooden THUMP, a fast air whoosh and a tiny hinge rattle accompany the motion. Bright golden daylight floods the doorway and sweeps across the floor, instantly revealing Ketkout, the small round fluffy yellow chick with three head feathers and a peach neckerchief. He makes one quick forward weight shift, plants both orange feet on the threshold and catches the open door with his little wing, settling into the supplied ending pose. The door remains intact and settles open after a small physical rebound. A brief, tight camera jolt at the impact immediately settles back to the original framing. Real-time snappy action, energetic acceleration and natural motion blur, followed by a short confident hold on his backlit reveal. Preserve the exact kitchen layout, fixed lens, tiny-house scale, character proportions, feather design and warm 3D materials. The only lighting change comes from the door opening. One continuous shot with no cuts, no additional characters, no dialogue and no music.

inputs.prompt: One playful five-second low-angle shot, camera locked just below the wooden table edge. The closed Comfyture jar stands motionless in the left foreground with its yellow label facing the lens. Behind the far edge, only Ketkout's round yellow crown and three feather tufts are visible. In the first second his crown bobs briskly toward the right as he walks past the jar. He suddenly stops at the right edge in a sharp comic double-take. After a tiny pause, his crown quickly reverses left toward the jar, still mostly hidden by the tabletop. His curious eyes peek just above the edge. He thrusts one short fluffy yellow wing upward in a fast decisive reach and curls its rounded feather tips around the right side of the jar, landing in the supplied final grip. Keep the jar upright and its label stable; it remains on the table until the cut. Crisp anticipation, fast reversal and quick grab, followed by a brief contact hold; real-time lively animation rather than slow motion. The table occludes his body throughout. Preserve the exact room geometry, camera angle, lighting, glass, lettering and fluffy chick design. Quick foot taps below frame, a short feather swish and soft glass contact. No dialogue, music, human hands, additional characters, scene changes or camera orbit.
